content.comment_body: Is it possible to add a toggle button in [product_name] Web Editor? I want to create a page that can toggle inputs directly to [product_name]. Any advice? Or is this only achievable through the [product_name] App? ...sent from App
You cannot create a toggle or push button in [product_name] Web Editor. This needs to be implemented in [product_name] Soft Comfort.

I've prepared a simple example for you. The main function is generated by connecting the network output to the same address as the network input. First, the network input is triggered with a signal and then the corresponding bit at the address is reset via the LOW block on the network output. As a result, the bit remains high for only one cycle.
Thank you very much! You are truly knowledgeable. I really appreciate your help. I followed your guide and the solution works very well. ...sent from App

Update regarding this topic: The workaround described above is only required for older versions of [product_name] Web Editor, specifically [version_no] V1.0.0 and V1.0.1. For V1.1.0 and the latest version V1.1.1, a built-in push button element is available, making the workaround unnecessary.

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced limitations in early releases of [product_name] Web Editor, which did not include toggle or push button functionality, making direct input control from the web interface impossible and requiring alternate solutions with [product_name] Soft Comfort. Later software versions resolved this by adding a push button feature.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to easily create a toggle button for direct input control via [product_name] Web Editor, without needing complex workarounds or multiple programs.
